description: The PAN arm of the H10 multi-phase pair: PAN's autodev loop plans, executes, verifies and completes each of the two phases, a fresh Claude Code session per unit, a real model.
why: Program H10, multi-phase: the claim PAN makes is about work that spans phases, where phase 2 depends on phase 1 holding its rules across restarts. Both arms see the same roadmap and requirements and are judged by the same hidden acceptance check (harness/scripts/check-tasks.cjs, one case per requirement edge). Run both arms together with --repeat N and an approved --max-usd.

pair.goal: Implement both phases of the roadmap in .planning/roadmap.md, meeting every requirement in .planning/requirements.md, with tests.

steps.why: autodev runs both phases to done, each unit in a fresh session, and the files the roadmap names exist.
Every requirement edge holds, across restarts, judged by a check neither arm saw.
